authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed public site source and exact private RSVP/deployment contracts; private address and response records remain outside public Git.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues and event specifications with explicit RSVP, calendar, privacy, and deployment acceptance criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Static validation plus disposable end-to-end RSVP, schema, abuse-control, calendar, timezone, expiry, and deletion tests.
authority.deployment_authority: Private protected deployment workflow and operator approval; public source has no access to the private address or RSVP store.

data.retention: RSVP identity, contact, attendance, and audit data is retained only for the event purpose and a declared post-event window.
data.deletion: Expired, withdrawn, test, or operator-deleted RSVP records are removed from active and backup data according to the declared event policy.
data.secret_storage: Event address, RSVP credentials, anti-abuse secrets, and deployment configuration remain in private protected storage.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Public site candidates and private RSVP deployments are independently replaceable; compromised grants and records can be revoked or deleted.

stabilization.summary: Qualify RSVP create/update/cancel flows, schema versions, idempotency, CSRF, abuse controls, and private-address disclosure in a disposable environment.
Implement explicit RSVP retention, event expiry, withdrawal, deletion, and backup-handling evidence.
Freeze calendar, timezone, locale, daylight-saving, and invitation identity behavior.
